data.reasoning: The package consists of a standard PKGBUILD and .SRCINFO for a Go application. The PKGBUILD downloads a pinned source tarball from GitHub with a valid SHA-256 checksum and uses standard build and install commands. The qwen model's inconclusive verdict was due to a transient LLM API error (HTTP 400) when reviewing the PKGBUILD, not a security finding. The deepseek model successfully reviewed all files and found no issues. The openrouter report (advisory) also confirmed it is safe.
data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement was caused by a tool error in the qwen model run, which failed with an HTTP 400 error when attempting to audit the PKGBUILD, resulting in an overall inconclusive verdict for that run. The deepseek model successfully audited the same file and found it safe.
coverage_issues: qwen/qwen3-235b-a22b-2507 failed to audit the PKGBUILD due to an LLM API error (HTTP 400).
learnings: Transient LLM API errors (like HTTP 400) should be handled with retries or fallback models rather than immediately failing the file audit and cascading to an inconclusive package verdict.
